goals.notes: I like the AI/compute theme long term. Keep me honest on risk - I over-concentrated in miners once already.

thesis: Your $300/month contributes $7,200 by mid-2028, so hitting $25,000 needs roughly 13% annualized growth — rotate SGOV's 35.8% into quality AI compounders on weakness while hard-capping miners at 10%.

Freeze IREN (RSI 30.6, down 36.6%) and CIFR — no adds; exit CIFR entirely on any bounce above $19 since the miner thesis already burned you.
Add $250 to AAPL only on a confirmed breakout close, since the setup alert fired and RSI 60.3 still has room before overbought.
Do not chase CRWD (RSI 71.9) or PANW (RSI 78.5); set alerts and buy CRWD only on a pullback below RSI 60.
Hold MSFT but add nothing while it sits below its long-term trend; reassess the position if the downtrend persists past early August.
Direct July and August's $300 contributions into TSM, building the $47 stub toward $650 while it holds its uptrend.

Build TSM to roughly 10% ($1,800+) by mid-2027 — leading-edge foundry is the chokepoint every AI name in your book depends on.
Open NEE near $88 and build Energy to 10%, capturing data-center power demand with lower volatility than your 1.44 portfolio beta.
Work SGOV down from 35.8% to 20% by mid-2027, deploying in $500-750 tranches only on 5%+ market pullbacks.
Treat IREN as a 10%-max satellite bet on its AI data-center pivot; exit permanently if it makes a new low below the current -36.6% cost basis.
Checkpoint the math every quarter: $12,143 plus contributions compounding at 13% reaches $25,000 by July 2028 without ever needing a moonshot.
guardrails: Combined IREN plus CIFR never exceeds 10% of portfolio value, and you never average down into any miner that is underwater.
No single stock above 12% of the portfolio, and SGOV never drops below 15% until total value passes $20,000.
If the portfolio falls 15% from its high, pause all buying and rebuild Cash & Income to 25% before re-entering.
Never open a new position with RSI above 70 — that rule currently blocks CRWD and PANW until they cool off.
Any position down 25% from cost triggers a written re-thesis or full exit within one week; IREN is the live test case.
milestones: By September 30, 2026: SGOV under 25%, miners under 10%, and portfolio value at or above $13,200.
By January 2027: portfolio at or above $14,800 with the core four (NVDA, AMD, TSM, MSFT) at 40%+ combined.
By July 2027 (midpoint): portfolio at or above $17,500 and Energy sleeve established near 10%.
By January 2028: portfolio at or above $21,000; if below, extend the timeline rather than adding leverage or miner risk.
By July 2028: $25,000 target hit with max drawdown held tighter than the current -22.2%.
